title: Position-only dirty derivation's never-saved branch ignores edges/preamble (latent divergence from computeDirty)
description: For the lastSavedSnapshot===null case, computeDirty returns `persistedFingerprint !== EMPTY_SNAPSHOT` (dirty if ANY of nodes/edges/preamble is non-empty), but the position-only sibling computeDirtyForPositionOnlyNodes returns `nodes.length > 0` only. On a never-saved workspace with zero nodes but non-empty edges or a non-empty preamble, these two disagree: computeDirty says dirty, computeDirtyForPositionOnlyNodes says clean. The two functions are meant to be drop-in equivalents for the position-only fast path. The divergence is currently UNREACHABLE because hasOnlyNodePositionChanges() (the only gate to this branch) returns false whenever both node arrays are empty (its per-index loop never runs, so positionChanged stays false), so setNodesRaw never reaches the position-only branch with nodes.length===0. It is therefore a dormant correctness inconsistency rather than an active bug, but it is a real trap for any future caller/refactor that reuses computeDirtyForPositionOnlyNodes or changes the gating predicate.
evidence: computeDirty null-branch (line 360): `selectIsDirty({lastSavedSnapshot:null}, persistedFingerprint)` => `persistedFingerprint !== EMPTY_SNAPSHOT` where EMPTY_SNAPSHOT = serialize({nodes:[],edges:[],preamble:''}). computeDirtyForPositionOnlyNodes null-branch (line 385): `return nodes.length > 0` — only inspects nodes, never edges or preamble. selectIsDirty/EMPTY_SNAPSHOT defined in utils/graphSnapshot.ts:121,133-141. Unreachability: hasOnlyNodePositionChanges (228-253) returns `positionChanged` initialized false; for empty arrays the loop body is skipped so it returns false, so setNodesRaw (530) never enters the position-only branch when nodes is empty.
